page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the page continues beyond this part. Right-edge column of small marginal numbers (I, I, I) is cut off. Some entries are partly faint; the Olympiad and reference numbers in the narrow column are read with some doubt. The numbers in the left and right margins and the year figures are as printed; the entries in the Anni mūdi column are the years of the world. Some marginal figures are very faint and only approximate.
